tools_required: canva; tiktok; youtube; excel; social media

position_overview:
We are seeking a highly creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer & Video Editor to join our team as an Independent Contractor. In this role, you will be responsible for producing compelling visual content-including digital graphics, social media assets, marketing materials, and video edits ranging from short reels to longer promotional formats.

If you excel in a fast-paced environment, possess strong time management skills, and have an impressive creative portfolio, we'd love to hear from you!
key_responsibilities:
Graphic Design:
- Create visually appealing graphics for social media, digital ads, banners, email campaigns, and branding materials.
- Develop both print and digital marketing collateral while maintaining brand consistency across all assets.
- Edit, retouch, and remove backgrounds from photos as needed.

Video Editing & Motion Graphics:
- Edit raw video footage into polished, engaging content for platforms such as Reels, TikTok, YouTube, and promotional ads.
- Add professional motion graphics, lower thirds, titles, captions, transitions, and manage audio syncing/mixing.
- Repurpose long-form videos into concise clips tailored for various social media platforms.

General & Workflow:
- Collaborate with the marketing and creative teams to brainstorm and conceptualize campaign ideas.
- Oversee multiple visual projects from initial concept to final delivery.
- Systematically organize and archive completed visual assets for easy future retrieval.

Qualifications & Requirements
- Experience: Demonstrated background as a Graphic Designer and Video Editor, with a portfolio and demo reel required.
- Technical Proficiency:
- Advanced expertise in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and After Effects).
- Experience with Canva or Figma is a plus.
- Equipment & Setup:
- High-performance PC or Mac capable of smooth video rendering and graphic processing.
- Reliable primary internet connection (25-50 Mbps or higher) and a backup internet solution.
- Quiet, dedicated workspace.
- Soft Skills:
- Strong portfolio highlighting creative design, color theory, typography, and video pacing.
- Excellent time management skills and the ability to meet deadlines independently.
- Proficient English communication skills (written and verbal).

Join us and bring your creative vision to life while making an impact through high-quality visual content!
